note: M8b: vulnerability scanning. With no scan running the app does nothing new: survey.sqlite, the scan queue and the power observers are created only when a Survey screen or Settings > Survey opens (never at launch), the queue holds no timer and registers observers only while images wait and the user has not paused, and the Vulnerabilities tab starts its report stores only while it is on screen. idle-1 and hidden below are the no-scan numbers. Against P1: idle-1 cpuAvgPct 0.14 vs 0.053 (budget 0.5) and footprintMB 108 vs 77 (budget 150); hidden cpuAvgPct 0.047 vs 0.0 (budget 0.1) and footprintMB 60 vs 55. Both runs were taken while other workers were building and testing on the same Mac (1-minute load 21 at the start of the first run, 6 at the second idle-1 run), so a relative difference of this size at these absolute values is load noise, not a change in app behaviour: no M8b code runs at idle. The first idle-1 attempt was rejected by the sampler (window not visible in any minute sample, a display-state issue; its CPU was 0.06 %, footprint 103 MB) and was repeated. hidden: the budgeted metric minPeriodicIntervalSec was reported as not measured by the sampler (an M4b metric); the other four hidden metrics pass. The footprint difference (+5 to +30 MB) should be re-checked in a quiet run (P2).

environment.machine: Apple silicon Mac, shared with four other workers
environment.uptime/load: idle-1 first attempt 21.2 at start (rejected, window not visible); idle-1 recorded run 6.3; hidden run started at load 21.2 (ended 5.7)
environment.cluster: minikube wheelhouse-test, wh-perf fixtures (seeded and removed around the runs)
environment.command: scripts/perf-sample.sh --scenario idle-1 --minutes 5 / --scenario hidden --minutes 10, Profile build, under the shared lock
